name: Hungry!
summary: Mudcrush Durtfeet, an ogre in northern Dustwallow Marsh, is hungry. Mud wants you to go bash the fishy Mirefin and bring back their heads, or Mud will eat you instead.

sections.title: A Hungry Ogre
sections.body: Mudcrush Durtfeet is a big ogre and says so plainly. Mud is hungry and has a simple bargain: go bash the fishy Mirefin and bring Mud their heads as food. Feed Mud, or Mud will eat you.

faq.answer: Mudcrush Durtfeet is a big ogre in northern Dustwallow Marsh who goes by Mud. Mud is hungry and wants food.

faq.q: What does Mudcrush Durtfeet want to eat?
faq.answer: Mud wants Mirefin heads, brought from the fishy Mirefin that you are told to bash.

faq.q: What happens if you refuse to feed him?
faq.answer: Mud makes it plain: feed Mud or Mud will eat you.
